bosses.name: It That Was Tul & It That Was Esh
bosses.accessChain: Using a Breachstone reveals a Breach Stronghold: several Atlas maps inside the Breach domain (Hives, then Hive and Sky Fortresses, with Tul and Esh at the core), each run with its own waystone (0.5.0 notes: "Using a Breachstone will reveal the maps inside the domain"; expcarry). The map count is unverified, so only the Breachstone is priced: net is a rough upper bound on value per Stronghold, not per map. The Breachlord Sac — the entry to Xesht — looks guaranteed per Tul & Esh kill (Game8, poe2db). The Stronghold maps' own loot is not counted either.

bosses.name: Xesht, We That Are One
bosses.accessChain: Kill It That Was Tul and It That Was Esh in a Breach Stronghold (revealed by a Breachstone — see their row) for a Breachlord Sac, and hand it to the Dreamer in the Monastery of the Keepers; each attempt consumes one Sac. The 50/100/150-splinter difficulty tiers are the pre-0.5 model and are not offered here. No drop rates are published. Breach Rings no longer drop (0.5.0).
